user.title: EDF Tarif Bleu
user.description: Pick your contract's option and power. Prices come from raphaelh.github.io/tarif-kwh (unofficial project).

data.heures_creuses: Off-peak hours of your meter, e.g. 22:00-06:00 (optional)
data.pointe_ejp: Entity telling whether today is an EJP peak day (optional)

data_description.couleur_tempo: For the "Current price" sensor with Tempo (states bleu/blanc/rouge or blue/white/red).
data_description.heures_creuses: For the "Current price" sensor with peak/off-peak. Several ranges allowed, comma separated.
data_description.pointe_ejp: For the "Current price" sensor with EJP (states on/off, or pointe/normal). Without it, the "normal" price is always used.
